summary: May's nonfarm payrolls came in at 172,000 — double consensus estimates — making it easy for the Fed to focus on inflation, and markets are now pricing a full 25bp rate hike this year. Broadcom's lackluster AI chip guidance sent the stock down 20%, rattling the AI trade and helping trigger the week's sharp tech selloff.
tweet: A blowout jobs print doubled estimates and pushed markets to price a full Fed rate hike, while Broadcom's AI miss and record Bitcoin ETF outflows deepened the cross-asset selloff.
